_about: Facts about each building. Everything here was read off evolution24.net and its Rent Manager listings on 22 September 2026 unless a field says otherwise. 'desc_source' is 'site' when the words are the old site's own, 'written' when the old site had no description and one was written from the listing facts and photos only. Review every 'written' one.

properties.name: 301 Central Avenue
properties.desc: Gorgeous, fully renovated apartments in the heart of downtown Rochester. Enjoy convenient living close to where you work and play. Choose from 1- or 2-bedroom apartments, furnished or unfurnished.

properties.name: 145 South Fitzhugh
properties.desc: Modern studio and 1-bedroom apartments on a quiet street just outside downtown Rochester. Perfect for singles or couples, and close to shopping, dining, schools and hospitals.

properties.name: Water Street
properties.desc: Gorgeous, fully updated loft apartments close to downtown Rochester, with plenty of space and elegant high ceilings. Both buildings offer studios as well as 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom homes. Enjoy modern conveniences and community-style living with a full on-site gym.

properties.name: The Biltmore
properties.desc: A classic yellow-brick apartment building on Alexander Street, with a restored lobby of mosaic tile, crystal and black lacquer. Furnished studios come with WiFi and appliances included, and pets are welcome.

properties.name: 181 St. Paul
properties.desc: Loft studios in a seven-storey brick building on St. Paul Street, downtown. Tall windows, plank floors and painted brick, a short walk from the river and the heart of the city.

properties.name: Charlotte Square
properties.desc: Seventy-two luxury apartments at the heart of Rochester's East End. Built in 2016 and LEED-designed, with granite, stainless and private outdoor space in every home, and a space in the secure garage included.

properties.name: 2215 James Street
properties.desc: Close to downtown Syracuse, this historic property has been updated and is ready for you to call it home. Shopping, dining and recreation are a short walk away. Rent includes all utilities, with laundry on site and a large driveway.

properties.name: 121 Park Drive
properties.desc: A beautifully restored Victorian mansion on a quiet, scenic street in Manlius that is still close to all the action. Shopping, dining and the outdoors are within walking distance, or stay close to home and enjoy a tranquil afternoon in the large backyard.

properties.name: 379 South Main
properties.desc: A generous home on South Main Street in Geneva, a few blocks above Seneca Lake. Original fireplaces, tall windows and chandeliers, with a dishwasher, central air and a washer and dryer in the unit.

properties.name: 561 South Main
properties.desc: Apartments in a white Italianate house on South Main Street in Geneva, renovated under their original pressed-tin ceilings, with a gas range and new baths.

properties.name: 31 Genesee Street
properties.desc: A two-storey house with a deep front porch on Genesee Street in Geneva.

rochester.name: Rochester
rochester.blurb: Downtown lofts, East End classics and a new-build community, from studios to three bedrooms.

syracuse.name: Syracuse & Manlius
syracuse.blurb: A historic home near downtown Syracuse and a restored Victorian in the village of Manlius.

geneva.name: Geneva
geneva.blurb: Houses on South Main and Genesee Street, above Seneca Lake in the Finger Lakes.
